title: Build a Xiangqi player that beats enhanced alpha-beta within a compute budget
hypothesis: The solver must locate the actual cost of the full player execution path and improve playing strength under fixed compute while preserving move-generation and state-transition semantics.
why_hard: The frozen v2 difficulty hypothesis did not hold: one fresh Terra/high trial completed normally and won 56/64 private games within the declared budget. A compact native rewrite was sufficient while preserving the Python API unchanged.
next_action: Retire v2 from hard-task selection. Preserve the viable task, passing Terra artifact and matched controls. Do not run conditional Sol or tighten this passed snapshot.
